thread.title: Apple reportedly warns suppliers it will need 20% fewer iPhone components for the 2nd half of the year (AAPL)

title: Apple reportedly warns suppliers it will need 20% fewer iPhone components for the 2nd half of the year (AAPL)
text:
facebook email copy link
John Gress/Reuters Apple has warned suppliers it will need 20% fewer iPhone components for the second half of the year, according to the Nikkei Asian review, citing industry sources. iPhone shipments are expected to total 80 million this year, less than 100 million Apple planned for at this time last year. Apple shares slipped more than 2% on the news.
(Reuters) - Apple Inc has asked its supply chain to manufacture about 20 percent fewer components for iPhones in the latter half of 2018, the Nikkei Asian Review on Friday cited industry sources as saying, sending the iPhone maker's stock down 2 percent.
Apple expects total shipments of iPhones to be launched this year to be 80 million, less than the 100 million shipments that Apple planned for around the same time last year, the financial newspaper said.
Shares of Apple, which usually launches iPhones in the second half of the year, fell 2.2 percent to $189.20.
Apple did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Advertisement
